title: SYNC: A Training-Free Inference Controller for Dynamic Layer Selection in Multi-Persona Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.02636v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Steering vectors align a model at inference time without touching its weights, but eliciting several personas at once is a different problem from eliciting one. Prior multi-persona steering approaches predetermine both how persona vectors are combined and the specific layers at which they are injected. Moreover, this static commitment introduces substantial offline search costs to identify suitable target layers, despite the fact that optimal intervention strengths vary dynamically across both decoding steps and distinct personas. We introduce SYNC (SensitivitY-guided iNference Control), a novel training-free inference control framework compatible with pre-existing steering vectors. SYNC dynamically estimates each layer's sensitivity to every persona via cosine similarity trajectories, assigning each persona to its optimal injection layer at every decoding step. translated_title: SYNC：一种用于多人格对齐中动态层选择的无训练推理控制器
translated_abstract: 转向向量（steering vectors）可以在推理时对模型进行对齐而无需改动其权重，但同时激发多个人格与激发单个人格是截然不同的问题。先前的多人格转向方法预先确定了人格向量的组合方式以及注入这些向量的特定层。此外，这种静态的预设带来了大量离线搜索成本来识别合适的目标层，尽管最佳干预强度实际上在解码步骤和不同人格之间都是动态变化的。我们提出了SYNC（SensitivitY-guided iNference Control，敏感性引导的推理控制），这是一种新颖的免训练推理控制框架，可与现有的转向向量兼容。SYNC通过余弦相似度轨迹动态估计每一层对每个人格的敏感性，并在每个解码步骤中将每个人格分配到其最佳的注入层。在两个模型、两个人格配置以及来自无监督（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: SYNC是一种免训练的推理控制框架，通过余弦相似度轨迹动态估计各层对每个人格的敏感性，从而在每个解码步骤中将人格向量注入最优层，解决了多人格对齐中静态层选择和离线搜索成本高昂的问题。
en_tdlr: SYNC is a training-free inference control framework that dynamically estimates each layer's sensitivity to every persona via cosine similarity trajectories, assigning persona vectors to their optimal injection layers at each decoding step to address the high offline search costs of static layer selection in multi-persona alignment.
